formats.name: long-form video
formats.notes: unverified accounts limited to 15 min (900 s); 256 GB or 12 h whichever is less; 9:16 and 1:1 also accepted; MP4 H.264 AAC recommended

formats.name: short
formats.notes: vertical, up to 3 minutes, uploads up to 1080p; px is convention

formats.name: thumbnail (video)
formats.notes: min 640 px wide; JPG or PNG; desktop 50 MB, mobile 2 MB; verified account required

formats.name: thumbnail (short)
formats.notes: min 640 px high; Studio on computer only

formats.name: live stream
formats.notes: verified channel, no live restriction in 90 days, age 16+
